note: One entry per item quality that can get a card. label is the quality word shown only after the flip; colour is the page's CSS class (--q-* variables in app.css); cue is the sound the page plays on the flip as [frequency in Hz, milliseconds] steps; text has 3 or more variants, chosen by the card number. The face of an unflipped card shows none of these.

face_down.title: Unidentified item
face_down.text: The hero picked something up that still hides what it is. Flip the card to find out.

magic.label: Magic
text: The item glows blue. It carries a charm or two.
A blue light: magic is in it.
It hums blue in the hand.

rare.label: Rare
text: Yellow fire: a rare, with several properties.
It blazes yellow. This one is worth a look.
A rare piece. The hero smiles.

set.label: Set item
text: Green light: a piece of a set.
It shines green. Somewhere there are others like it.
A set item. It wants company.

unique.label: Unique
text: Gold-brown light: a unique, one of a kind.
A unique! It has a name of its own.
The item rings out: one of a kind.

crafted.label: Crafted
text: A craftsman's work, with a fine edge.
It glows orange, made by hand.
